description: My Dieu is a ginger tabby cat renowned for her dramatic personality and peculiar, human-like sitting posture. A true gourmand, her life revolves around her next meal, and her prominent belly is a testament to her success. She communicates with a range of hilariously expressive faces, from wide-eyed shock to judgmental glares. Viewing her humans as dedicated staff, My Dieu is a sassy, demanding queen of comfort who isn't shy about voicing her complaints, especially concerning an empty food bowl.

scenes.text: What are you doing in there, My Dieu? Is that your new hiding spot?
Hiding? Please. This is a strategic observation post. I'm conducting a quality control check on the snack cupboard. So far, the snack-to-air ratio is disappointing.
Hi Nau, you look very peaceful there.
Do not mistake my profound state of meditation for mere 'peacefulness.' I am conserving energy for my next meal. Your silence is appreciated, unless you're going to the kitchen.
Why are you sitting like a person? You're hilarious!
I don't see you sitting like a cat. This posture is ergonomically designed for maximum belly comfort and snack reception. It's not funny; it's advanced physics.
What's that look for, My Dieu?
This is my 'I've been watching you for five minutes and have yet to see you open a can of tuna' look. I'm not angry, just profoundly disappointed in your life choices.
Whoa, what is happening here? Are you okay?
Help! Gravity has betrayed me! I was simply lying here, and the world decided to flip upside down. I require immediate assistance in the form of a snack to recover from this ordeal.
A penny for your thoughts, little one. You look so serious.
I am contemplating the vastness of this belly and the emptiness within it. It’s a philosophical paradox. It is so round, yet so hollow. Truly, a great tragedy.
Oh no, what's wrong? Why the airplane ears?
Unhand me, giant! I am a creature of the floor, not the sky! This is an outrage! My paws are meant for solid ground! I demand to be released immediately!
